1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#16252c">
<title>السبّاك في البيت</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Almarai:wght@400;700;800&display=swap');
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#16252c;font-family:Almarai,"Noto Sans Arabic",Arial,sans-serif;touch-action:none}canvas{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh;touch-action:none}
</style>
</head>
<body><canvas id="game" aria-label="لعبة السباك في البيت"></canvas>
<script>
(()=>{
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=1280,H=720,N=5,dirs=[{x:0,y:-1,n:'N'},{x:1,y:0,n:'E'},{x:0,y:1,n:'S'},{x:-1,y:0,n:'W'}];
let dpr=1,scale=1,ox=0,oy=0,board=[],level=1,hints=2,won=false,muted=false,started=performance.now(),winAt=0,waterTick=0,hover=null;
const routes=[[[0,2],[1,2],[1,1],[2,1],[2,0],[3,0],[3,1],[4,1],[4,2]],[[0,2],[1,2],[1,3],[2,3],[2,4],[3,4],[3,3],[4,3],[4,2]],[[0,2],[1,2],[1,1],[2,1],[3,1],[3,0],[4,0],[4,1],[4,2]],[[0,2],[1,2],[2,2],[2,1],[2,0],[3,0],[3,1],[3,2],[4,2]]];
const bx=72,by=158,cell=88,gap=8;
function resize(){dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=innerWidth*dpr;canvas.height=innerHeight*dpr;scale=Math.min(innerWidth/W,innerHeight/H);ox=(innerWidth-W*scale)/2;oy=(innerHeight-H*scale)/2;ctx.setTransform(dpr*scale,0,0,dpr*scale,dpr*ox,dpr*oy)}
addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();
function rand(n){return Math.floor(Math.random()*n)}
function mod(v,n){return ((v%n)+n)%n}
function rotate(conns,r){return conns.map(d=>mod(d+r,4))}
function dirsFor(a,b){const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];return [dy<0?0:dx>0?1:dy>0?2:3]}
function edgeDir(a,b){if(b[0]>a[0])return 1;if(b[0]<a[0])return 3;if(b[1]>a[1])return 2;return 0}
function newGame(){won=false;winAt=0;started=performance.now();const route=routes[(level-1)%routes.length],map=new Map();
for(let i=0;i<route.length;i++){let con=[];if(i>0)con.push(edgeDir(route[i],route[i-1]));if(i<route.length-1)con.push(edgeDir(route[i],route[i+1]));let kind=i===0?'source':i===route.length-1?'sink':con[0]%2===con[1]%2?'straight':'elbow';if(kind==='straight')con=[con[0],mod(con[0]+2,4)];map.set(`${route[i][0]},${route[i][1]}`,{x:route[i][0],y:route[i][1],kind,base:con,rot:rand(4),solution:con.slice()});}
board=[];for(let y=0;y<N;y++)for(let x=0;x<N;x++){let t=map.get(`${x},${y}`);if(!t){let kind=Math.random()<.54?'elbow':'straight',base=kind==='elbow'?[0,1]:[0,2];t={x,y,kind,base,rot:rand(4),solution:[]};}board.push(t)}
if(connected().won){const start=board.find(t=>t.kind==='source');start.rot=mod(start.rot+1,4)}
}
function actual(t){return rotate(t.base,t.rot)}
function connected(){const start=board.find(t=>t.kind==='source'),visited=new Set();if(!start)return {visited,won:false};let q=[start];visited.add(`${start.x},${start.y}`);while(q.length){let t=q.shift();for(const d of actual(t)){const nx=t.x+dirs[d].x,ny=t.y+dirs[d].y;if(nx<0||nx>=N||ny<0||ny>=N)continue;const n=board[ny*N+nx],back=mod(d+2,4);if(actual(n).includes(back)){let key=`${nx},${ny}`;if(!visited.has(key)){visited.add(key);q.push(n)}}}}return {visited,won:visited.has('4,2')}}
function rounded(x,y,w,h,r,fill,stroke,lw=1){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);if(fill){ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill()}if(stroke){ctx.lineWidth=lw;ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.stroke()}}
function text(s,x,y,size,color,align='right',weight=700){ctx.font=`${weight} ${size}px Almarai, Arial, sans-serif`;ctx.textAlign=align;ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillText(s,x,y)}
function line(x1,y1,x2,y2,color,width=1){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.stroke()}
